findings.description: Removing `__reduce_ex__` breaks pickle round trips for both sentinels because their enum values are plain `object()` instances.
findings.rationale: When `UNSET`, `FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE`, or an object containing either sentinel is pickled and then unpickled, Enum's default reducer reconstructs the member by value. Unpickling creates a different object that matches neither enum value, causing `ValueError`. The removed reducer reconstructed by member name and avoided this failure.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python -c 'import enum,pickle,copy; S=enum.Enum(\"S\", {\"UNSET\":object()}); print(copy.copy(S.UNSET) is S.UNSET); print(copy.deepcopy(S.UNSET) is S.UNSET); print(pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(S.UNSET)))'"
